text.description_html:
First Impressions DS-ARx400 4" Round Acrylic Door Stops

Contemporary design 4 inch acrylic baseboard door stop from the First Impressions Acrylic Collection. They are made from Crystal Clear Acrylic. Easy to install with included mounting hardware.

Pictured below is a clear acrylic door stop on a bath room door. These door stops are So Clear They Disappear.

These 4" length acrylic door stops screw onto the baseboard casement, door bottom or wall anchor, to protect not just the wall and door, but your door knob or lever as well.

Specifications for First Impressions DS-ARx400 Round Acrylic Door Stop

  • Total Length: 4"
  • Diameter: 3/4"
  • Material: Extruded Acrylic

Sold Individually.





** This item is discontinued.
